summary: Wrote a 6-phase, 4.5-hour implementation plan for making specs/archive/state.json validatable by validate-state.sh. The plan closes both halves of the defect research identified: the base-mode false PASS (Checks 5/6/7 reporting clean when their .active_projects jq pipelines error into zero output lines) and the total absence of an archive code path. Direction chosen per research Recommendation 1: an explicit --archive flag with its own parallel check set (A1-A6) over archived_projects/completed_projects, advisory-first on every check that collides with this repo's live archive data. Phases are strictly sequential since all six touch the two declared file_scope files.

artifacts.summary: 6-phase plan adding an explicit --archive mode to validate-state.sh, closing the base-mode false-PASS, and extending test-validate-state.sh with seven archive fixture groups.
